capabilities.description: Load a known example ID into a new editable document; protects unsaved work and optional document generation

mutation_preconditions.combination: A revision guard is required; all supplied revision/document guards must match
mutation_preconditions.expected_command_revision: Guards admitted commands, including other actors; live solver publication does not invalidate it
mutation_preconditions.expected_document_generation: Optional mutation context guard; prevents applying an old rendered action to a replacement document, including background publication
mutation_preconditions.expected_revision: Guards all state publication, including live samples

discovery.retry_retention: Latest 256 successful mutation keys per session; reconnect to the same process preserves them. Expired keys have no deduplication guarantee.

checks: independent load-line and both captured ideal-edge sides
live inversion and simultaneous conduction at intermediate input
Verify preserves live physics and captures both model dependencies
paused edit stales; dirty reset refuses; saved edited origin/capture reopens fresh
limitations: generic pinned pair with zero gate charge/capacitance/delay; not a physical logic-gate or switching-loss qualification
explicit 10k output load; independent reference omits <=1nA reverse body leakage
public API/native callbacks are separate from full mounted keyboard/pointer/accessibility acceptance
